errors.evidence: This phrase, which attempts to describe the black diagonal line, is nonsensical. "Лицентирането на данните" means "Data licensing".
The black diagonal line starts at coordinate (30, 30), not (38, 38).
The description fails to mention the specific data point labels that are present on the chart for several countries (e.g., 92.6; 70.9 for Czechia, 87.0; 82.7 for Slovenia, etc.).
The description does not explain the significance of the black diagonal line, which represents the hypothetical perfect price convergence (where the GDP index equals the price level index).
